subject: equating of MIRT models created with the mirt package

messages.author: 45cefc3c98ca5722
messages.subject: equating of MIRT models created with the mirt package
parts:
Hi all,

I would like to equate/link three forms of a test, each modeled by a three dimensional 2PL model with the mirt package: mirt(mzp_i_tasks,3,SE=TRUE,itemtype = "2PL"), i=1,2,3, by an anchor test design.

Could anybody give me a hint which R package can do this (I know about the package equateIRT but it does not seem to support multidimensional models and the new plink package which seems to be no longer connectable to mirt via read.mirt because this function is missing in the mirt 1.24 release - please correct me if I'm wrong)?

Any help is highly appreciated. Thank's in advance!

Mike

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: equating of MIRT models created with the mirt package
parts:
I'm not overly aware of reliable equating techniques for exploratory IRT models, nor would I really recommend them anyway. Your best be will likely be to equate the models using the multipleGroup() function after first selecting some anchor items/parameters and freely estimating the focal group hyper-parameters. But, I would really recommend using a confirmatory IRT model first though, because for EFA models you cannot freely estimate the latent means and variances required to do the equating. 

Phil
